verdict.rationale: Tavily documents its own API endpoints for getting account data out: API key and account usage details, and per-request usage logs for the keys under an account or organization. As an API service, it holds little user data beyond these. Nothing in the evidence describes a complete account export, the output format, or account-deletion/offboarding. missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV), account deletion/offboarding process, independent corroboration.
